provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.title: Recoverable payment/refund operations and ambiguous outcomes
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.observed: checkoutLocked creates the order then calls the provider; every thrown provider error releases reserved stock and records failed. refundOrderLocked calls the external refund before recording its transaction/result. Webhook effects run before saveWebhookEvent. withCommerceLock is a mutex/advisory lock, not a transaction covering all writes or external effects.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.required_before_live: Persist stable operation identities and explicit attempted/unknown/confirmed/failed states; reconcile unknown outcomes without blindly recharging/refunding; journal authenticated events before resumable effects and bind effects to provider event/transaction identity. Preserve stock and entitlements according to confirmed state.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.offline_acceptance_to_add: Controlled fake-provider accepted-then-timeout, interrupted charge/refund, concurrent duplicate attempts, interrupted partial-refund effects, retry/reconciliation and file/MySQL/MariaDB state readback. These are proposed future checks, not tests run by this audit.

provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.title: A strict normalized payment result and event boundary
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.observed: The provider interface returns generic arrays. The reducer locates an order from order_number and applies paid/refund/chargeback using local amount/currency without requiring a normalized match of provider, merchant/environment, remote transaction, expected amount and currency. The HTTP entry reads an unbounded raw body and a single sandbox signature header. Existing security coverage is the sandbox HMAC contract.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.required_before_live: Define allowlisted normalized results/events and validated statuses; bind the verified provider event to the correct installation/provider environment, order, transaction, amount/currency and subscription period where relevant; bound request parsing and persist only needed safe metadata. Invalid/mismatched/unknown events must not grant or revive access. The selected adapter supplies its actual signature/header/freshness rules.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.offline_acceptance_to_add: Reject cross-provider/order/transaction/amount/currency binding mismatches, malformed/oversized events, conflicting replays and unsupported transitions; retain legitimate duplicate/out-of-order behavior with local fakes. Preserve sandbox regression compatibility explicitly.

references.section: Sandbox signature, duplicate and late-paid controls

provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.title: Provider-aware recurring subscription lifecycle
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.observed: fulfillOrder fabricates a sub_ identifier and local trial/period dates. The interface has no remote agreement/cancel/resume methods. cancelSubscription and resumeSubscription update local records only; non-sandbox renewals are deferred. The webhook reducer supports only order.paid/refunded/chargeback and ignores other event types.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.required_before_live: Define capabilities and commands for real agreement creation/cancel/resume plus normalized renewal/payment-failure/cancellation state changes. Preserve authoritative remote agreement IDs and periods. Couple access to confirmed provider outcomes and make unsupported operations explicit. Bind trial/free initial checkout to a real recurring agreement when required. Privacy closure must continue to require external billing review until an actual cancellation is confirmed.
provider_independent_pre_live_engineerin.selected_provider_dependency: Actual agreement creation, billing semantics, remote cancellation/resume calls, event mapping and reconciliation require the selected merchant/provider protocol.

references.section: No-charge branch, plan fulfillment, local cancellation/resumption, deferred live renewal and event switch

provider_dependent_engineering.title: Actual live payment adapter and checkout integration
provider_dependent_engineering.required: After provider selection, implement its official hosted/tokenized checkout and return flow, server authentication/API transport, test/live account separation, signed callbacks, recurring agreements, refunds, chargebacks and reconciliation. Add the real provider to the registry; render appropriate live UI instead of test-card/result selectors; add safe owner configuration and provider-contract fixtures plus actual merchant acceptance.
provider_dependent_engineering.why_not_credentials_only: Only SandboxPaymentProvider is registered; sandbox charge/refund fabricate IDs/results and make no provider calls; the current public checkout explicitly collects test input and labels all options Test Mode.
owner_choices: Approved payment processor and merchant account for the actual site/content/business model
One-time PPV/rental/merchandise and recurring membership capabilities, currencies and merchant region
Trial, recurring interval, cancellation/refund and grace-period rules to be enforced
Provider's test/live integration method, account identifiers and secure credentials/webhook configuration
Real HTTPS origin/return/callback destinations and specifically authorized merchant test transactions

provider_dependent_engineering.title: Conditional alternative provider adapters
provider_dependent_engineering.required: The shipped verified mail-event protocol is SendGrid and the shipped age protocol is Yoti document age verification. Selecting a different event or age provider entails a separate protocol adapter and acceptance; arbitrary credentials are not interchangeable.

Configure needed notification, scene, privacy, billing and mail-event workers separately; a successful local worker run does not install cron.
